note.zh-TW: 教材部分頁面與模板寫作「應付賬款」或「應付貨款」；介面統一寫「應付帳款」，原字列為別名。
note.en: Some course pages and the template write this term with a variant character or as goods payable; the interface uses one spelling and keeps the originals as aliases.

definition.zh-TW: 向供應商賒購、約定之後才付的貨款。在付清之前它是流動負債；付款時這筆負債和現金一起減少。
definition.en: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods bought on credit. It stays a current liability until it is settled, when both the liability and cash go down.
